source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Πάμβος «Καθολικός Γεωργίας»»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the whole of its body is a citation and nothing else: «Η μνήμη του Αγίου Πάμβου αναφέρεται στο Ιεροσολυμιτικόν Κανονάριον σελ. 88.» **This is the thinnest entry of the three days read** and it is drafted with `types` left empty on purpose. The listing's office is in saint.gr's own quotation marks — «Καθολικός Γεωργίας» — and a catholicos has no slug in the corpus's closed `types` vocabulary; `patriarch` would be an equation the page does not make, and adding a slug is a code commit. So the folder records a name, a day, and an office in the source's own scare quotes, and nothing else. **If the run would rather have no folder than this one, this is the row to drop**; the reader's judgement was that the office is data and the entry is a person, and that a folder saying plainly that the Jerusalem Kanonarion page 88 is the whole record is worth more than silence. He is not `pambo-of-egypt` or `pamvo-of-nitria`, both Egyptian ascetics. No year, no century, no hymn, no relic.
